title: greengrass-deployment#component-connection
description: Connect a Greengrass component to a greengrass-deployment project, adding it to the deployment's component map

exampleOption.description: An example option. Refer to https://nx.dev/extending-nx/recipes/generator-options for more info

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
